explanation: Kit-case Path B uses a 37-point / 1.25° mechanical rotor sweep at fixed commanded current angle -30° elec. with FOC-style excitation that tracks the rotor (see em_fia_front_kit_case.run_rotor_position_sweep). Mean |T| = 122.10 N·m over that sweep. Dense MTPA samples only 9 positions over 0–45° mech at the same commanded angle label, with phase excitation angle = command + pole-pairs×θ_mech (em_fia_mtpa_screen excitation_tracking). At -30° the dense mean |T| = 53.24 N·m (min 20.54, max 92.71). These are NOT interchangeable headlines. The HEADLINE torque story is the kit-case position-sweep mean. Dense peak on the full grid (106.87 N·m) and dense best-angle mean (55.71 N·m @ -20°) are secondary map metrics.
rule: Do not replace headline kit-case mean with dense@angle mean.
